description: Run one script in the app's code mode, in its sandbox, over the same read tools as the app's window, and record the run in the open case. A script that was accepted but failed answers with its result (status error, timeout, cancelled or crashed) and the command line then exits with the code of the failure. Needs code mode switched on in the app.

code.description: The script, at most 262144 bytes of UTF-8

caseId.description: The open case to record the run in; needed when more than one case is open

timeoutMs.description: How long the script itself may run, in milliseconds. 0 or left out means 30000; less than 1000 is raised to 1000. The command option --timeout-ms takes 1000 to 120000

reason.description: Why the script is run, kept with the run in the case

allowIdentifiers.description: Show user identifiers in the result; refused unless the operator allows it in the app
